pages.text: Welcome to $(l)Head Office$(). Noggin & Sons takes your head off, keeps it alive in a jar and lets your body walk on without it.$(br2)This handbook is issued on your first day. Lost it? A book and a $(item)Surgical Steel Blend$() make another.

$(li)Smelt Surgical Steel.$(li)Build a Galvanic Pile; fuel it.$(li)Make 4 Cranial Saline.$(li)Build and load the Separation Chair.$(li)Sit, sign, collect your head.$(br2)The Shopping List says what to bring.
pages.title: Your First Day
